name: Quest Hider
summary: Hide unwanted quests from your journal and their objective icons from maps. Restore them anytime with a dedicated hidden-quest list, without changing quest progress.

requirements.name: GOG Re-Reckoning with Fatesworn
requirements.note: Supported GOG executable only; other builds disabled.

main_file.name: Quest Hider 1.0.0
main_file.description: Hide and restore quests using F6/F7. Requires the supported GOG build with Fatesworn and Mod Framework v1.4. Extract the complete ZIP beside koa.exe. All Quest Markers is optional.

suggested_changelog: Initial 1.0.0 release: journal hiding/restoration, hidden-quest list, objective-icon filtering, character-name profiles, configurable F6/F7 controls and journal hints.
